1u3iaen.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1u3iaen.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

fk7zco.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR23665
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Operative with extensive combat experience needed to retrieve a blackbox from a compromised ship at [LOCATION]. Client hasn’t specified why they need it but are paying good money to have it back.
Analysis of the wreck indicates that there are some serious hostiles in the area, so any attempt to retrieve will likely require a fight. Our records indicate that these hostiles are highly trained and aggressive, so prepare accordingly.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Route to [LOCATION] and secure the blacbox by any means necessary. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION] for payment.
Additional Notes:
Operations wanted to reiterate that this will be a heavy combat mission so make sure you bring allies or equipment to handle it.
fk7zco.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR23665
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
需要一名具有丰富战斗经验的特工从 [LOCATION] 的一艘受损飞船中取出黑匣子。客户没有说明他们为何需要这个黑匣子，但他们愿意支付丰厚的报酬来取回它。

对残骸的分析表明，该地区有一些危险的敌对势力，因此任何取回黑匣子的尝试都可能引发战斗。我们的记录显示这些敌对势力训练有素且具有攻击性，所以请做好相应准备。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [LOCATION]，想尽一切办法确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送到 [DESTINATION] 以获取报酬。

补充说明：
运营部门再次强调，这将是一次高强度战斗任务，请确保带上盟友或相应的装备来应对。

wj1ma2.description_en:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.
Already got a spot picked out. If you get to [LOCATION] there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the [TARGET] and its escorts to pass by.
With a bonus of 16 Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.
- Stows

埋伏点都选好了——去 [LOCATION] 那片辐射云后面猫着。带上兄弟关掉引擎，等 [AMBUSHTARGET] 和护航队经过就动手。

主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 ，光这点就够赚了，而且残骸里的破烂也归你。

- 斯托斯

You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

看来他们的损失能让我们也赚不少。

1ja137o.description_en:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.
Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.
Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 24 MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

1ja137o.description_zh:
需要个身经百战的飞行员执行一个重要巡逻任务。有位大客户受够了不法分子老是袭击他们的飞船和卫星。我们受雇去可疑区域扫描，并解决所有敌对势力。巡逻任务从 HUD 上的位置标记开始，之后还要去其他几个指定地点进行清场。

不清楚会遇上什么，但根据客户提供的情报，那片区域经常有大概 5 到 7 艘飞船组成的战机编队游荡，有时甚至还有大型飞船带队。这意味着你最好为一场恶战做好准备。如果可以的话，尽量招募至少三个朋友加入。即使是经验丰富的飞行员，在对付这群人时也需要所有能得到的帮助。

鉴于这次任务会很棘手，巡逻结束后主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

40esi9.description_en:
Hey,
The folks at [LOCATION] have what I like to call a “pilot’s special” waiting to be distributed - a haul of quantum fuel, hydrogen fuel, and ship ammo. Load it up from a freight elevator and deliver it to the following spots in whatever order works best for you. Expect the containers to all be 16 SCU or smaller.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
